subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should this release remove the file-shaped Plugin SDK session APIs immediately, or keep narrow deprecated adapters for a named transition window while runtime storage becomes SQLite-only?
rationale: The PR removes a shipped plugin API family while changing the canonical persistent data model; tests cannot determine the intended ecosystem compatibility and release contract.

options.title: Stage SDK removal
options.body: Make core runtime SQLite-only now, but retain narrow deprecated Plugin SDK adapters for one explicit release window with compatibility tests and removal documentation.

options.title: Approve immediate removal
options.body: Remove the APIs now and explicitly own the breaking plugin upgrade with ecosystem, migration, downgrade, and release proof.

options.title: Pause the cutover
options.body: Keep the migration unmerged until maintainers define the permanent SDK and downgrade policy.

recommendation.title: Stage SDK removal
recommendation.body: Make core runtime SQLite-only now, but retain narrow deprecated Plugin SDK adapters for one explicit release window with compatibility tests and removal documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current-main lifecycle contract this branch must preserve and is the strongest available owner for the cross-cutting product and compatibility decision.
